title: Create P26
body:
# Create P26
**_Create Mod-Pack / Pengu 2026_**

_"Pengu" is the name of the community from which this modpack was made by and for_

### A carefully crafted modpack inspired by the Create Aeronautics mod

This modpack has a heavy focus on some handpicked Create Mods, which are the focus of this modpack.
To spice up the experience, some other mods are added on top to keep things smoothed out, feel more complete and enjoyable.

A careful consideration has been taken when looking into other mods, that could improve the modpack, especially in combination with the Create mods. These include mods such as: Travellers Backpack, Distant Horizons, Better Than Mending, Double Doors and others.

There are of course optimization and QoL mods.
